entries.rationale: Separate historical preparation, evidenced publication and new documentation review; preserve original tags, archives and human decisions.
audiences: All four IHK IT occupations and all four IT specialist disciplines
readerPaths: README -> joint issue overview -> per-preset improvement profile -> immutable sources -> exact new PR head -> human review
entries.navigationImpact: Paired README entries link the new source-only dossier; dated reports remain historical.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and equivalent English; paired README files and bilingual dossier.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Fourteen local suites and 49 stable declarations; 42 local rendered reader paths; actual per-head native CI retained separately.
entries.risk: Publication, tests, human approval, catalogue inclusion and consumer installation must not be conflated.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Tag, release, source, evidence, authority, scope or PR-head drift.
